Description: PRELIMINARIES AND GENERAL ITEMS
Site establishment, hoarding and site offices
Tower crane hire including operator (14 months)
Site security and watchmen
Temporary water and electricity, including bills
Insurances and performance bond
SUBSTRUCTURE
Excavation in earth for pile caps and basement not exceeding 3 m deep
Bored cast-in-situ piles, 600 mm diameter, grade 30 concrete
Grade 30 concrete in pile caps and ground beams
High-yield steel reinforcement in substructure
Bituminous waterproofing membrane to basement walls and slab, 4 mm
SUPERSTRUCTURE - REINFORCED CONCRETE FRAME
Grade 30 concrete in columns and shear walls
Grade 30 concrete in suspended slabs and beams, 150 mm average
High-yield steel reinforcement in frame
Formwork to soffits of slabs and beams
Formwork to columns and walls
Staircases, in-situ concrete including finishes
MASONRY
Cement block walls, 150 mm, in 1:5 cement mortar
Cement block walls, 100 mm partitions
Cement:sand plaster 1:5, 16 mm, internal walls
External render with waterproof additive, 20 mm
ROOFING AND WATERPROOFING
Torch-on membrane to roof slab, two layers with insulation
Liquid waterproofing to wet areas
Rainwater gutters and downpipes, uPVC 110 mm
FINISHES
Homogeneous floor tiles 600 x 600 mm, laid on screed
Ceramic wall tiles to bathrooms and kitchens, full height
Gypsum board ceilings on galvanised frame, painted
Emulsion paint, three coats, internal walls and ceilings
Weatherproof paint, external, three coats
Aluminium windows and sliding doors, powder coated, 6 mm glass
Timber flush doors with frames and ironmongery
MECHANICAL ELECTRICAL AND PLUMBING
Electrical installation per apartment, wiring and fittings
Main LV panel, rising mains and earthing
Plumbing per apartment, hot and cold water, sanitary ware
Passenger lifts, 13-person, 12 stops
Fire detection, alarm and sprinkler system
Sump, pumps and overhead water tanks
EXTERNAL WORKS
Interlocking paving to driveways, 80 mm on base
Boundary wall with gate, 2.1 m high
Storm water drains, precast covers
Landscaping and turfing
